summary: Write concrete reader-facing product content from verified evidence without private leakage or internal process narration.

outcomes: Turn authoritative product facts into concise audience-directed content.
Remove unsupported claims, generic filler, repetition, and private context leakage.

scenarios.title: Rewrite product documentation
scenarios.prompt: Use the write-product-content skill to revise this documentation for developers while preserving its approved structure and presentation.
scenarios.outcome: The content leads with developer outcomes, uses verified commands, and removes process-centered filler.

scenarios.title: Prepare concise release copy
scenarios.prompt: Use the write-product-content skill to turn these verified release facts into concise consumer-facing copy.
scenarios.outcome: The release text states concrete user impact without commit narration or unsupported significance.
